text: About About As an aspiring computer engineer student, I am building a solid foundation in machine learning, computer vision, and full-stack development while exploring new algorithms and technologies. My technical experience includes Python, JavaScript, Go, and frameworks like TensorFlow, OpenCV, MediaPipe, React, and Flask. I also have knowledge of databases and cloud platforms. I enjoy solving problems that combine innovation with real-world effects. This ranges from experimenting with gesture-based human-computer interaction to creating intelligent systems that improve security, accessibility, and user experience. In each project, I focus on writing clear, maintainable code while enhancing my understanding of algorithms and data-driven decision-making. I am excited to take on roles where I can make a meaningful contribution, learn quickly, and work with diverse teams. My aim is to grow into a well-rounded professional who not only keeps up with technological changes but also helps shape them by developing scalable, ethical, and impactful solutions.
